manifest.extDescription: Adds the films and episodes you watch to your {product} diary.
receipt.held.braked: {product} paused this connection — review in the app
receipt.dismissed.revoked: Not added — this connection was removed
receipt.dismissed.account_deletion: Not added — the account was deleted
receipt.expired: Not added — it waited too long for an answer
status.waiting: {count, plural, one {# viewing} other {# viewings}} to confirm in {product}
status.paused_indefinitely: Tracking paused until you turn it back on
status.disconnected: Not connected — connect {product} to add what you watch
status.connection_broken: Reconnect {product} to keep adding what you watch
status.connection_expiring: Reconnect {product} soon to keep adding what you watch
status.check.braked: {product} paused this connection, so plays are held until you review it in the app.
status.check.suspended: Your account is being deleted, so {product} isn't keeping new plays.
status.problem.plus_lapsed: {product} Plus ended — plays are held for 30 days
status.problem.braked: {product} paused this connection — review in the app
connect.result.cancelled: Not connected — the window closed before you approved. Connecting needs {product} Plus; if you have it, connect again.
connect.result.code_invalid: That took too long — connect again.
connect.result.token_invalid: That isn't a personal token. Copy it again from {product}'s settings.
connect.result.proof_invalid: This browser's key didn't work — connect again.
connect.result.forbidden: {product} didn't allow the connection. It needs {product} Plus, and you need to be signed in to {product} where you approve it.
connect.result.limit_reached: You have ten connected services — remove one in {product}, then connect again.
connect.result.feature_closed: Connected services aren't available in {product} yet.
connect.error.no_strategy: This build of the {product} extension has no way to connect.
connect.error.failed: Something went wrong while connecting — try again.
connect.token.label: Personal token
connect.token.hint: For builds of the {product} extension you made yourself. Create one in {product}, under Settings, then Connected services.
sites.all.title: Also track films and episodes on other sites
sites.all.detail: Chrome asks once for access to all sites. Pages that don't say they're a film or an episode are ignored.
sites.all.chrome_wording: Chrome words this as "read and change all your data on all websites". The extension needs it only so its reader can recognise a film or an episode on any site you watch on.
sites.all.declined: Chrome didn't allow it, so other sites aren't tracked.
welcome.connect.title: Connect {product}
welcome.connect.body: Adds what you watch to your diary. It can't read your library or anything else.
welcome.connect.data: While a film or an episode plays on a streaming site, the {product} extension reads what the page says it is and how far you've got, and keeps that in this browser. Once you connect, it sends {product} what you watched: its titles, years, season and episode, when you watched it and how far. Never the page's address or anything else you browse.
welcome.connect.note: If asked, sign in to {product}, then approve.
welcome.where.title: Where to track
welcome.where.body: These services are tracked already: their access came with the install.
welcome.where.later: For any other site, you can allow that single site later from the toolbar button while it plays.
welcome.done.title: Done
welcome.done.body: Watch something — it's added once you've watched enough of it.
welcome.done.pin_body: Extensions can't pin themselves. Open the puzzle-piece menu next to the address bar and pin it there.
options.heading: Settings
options.connection.title: Connection
options.connection.none_detail: Connect {product} to add what you watch to your diary.
options.connection.broken_key: This browser's key is gone, so nothing can be added until you connect again.
options.connection.broken_refused: {product} no longer accepts this connection. Connect again to keep adding what you watch.
options.connection.with_window: Adds the films and episodes you watch to your diary. It can't read your library.
options.connection.ends_detail: The date the server gave for this connection. Each film or episode added can move it later.
options.connection.until_detail: Each film or episode added moves this later, up to a year after connecting.
options.connection.disconnect_confirm: This browser forgets its connection and its key, so the connection can never be used again, and deletes everything it keeps for your account: the history under Recently, what you're watching now, and plays not sent yet. Your settings and sites stay.
options.connection.disconnect_unsent: {count, plural, one {# play hasn't been sent yet. Send it first, or delete it with the rest.} other {# plays haven't been sent yet. Send them first, or delete them with the rest.}}
options.connection.disconnect_unsent_bro: {count, plural, one {# play hasn't been sent yet. Without a working connection it can't be sent, so it is deleted too.} other {# plays haven't been sent yet. Without a working connection they can't be sent, so they are deleted too.}}
options.connection.disconnect_account: Plays already sent stay in your {product} account. To remove them, or this connection, open Connected services in {product}.
options.connection.send_first: {count, plural, one {Send # first, then disconnect} other {Send # first, then disconnect}}
options.connection.delete_unsent: {count, plural, one {Disconnect and delete it} other {Disconnect and delete them}}
options.connection.sending_first: Sending what is left — this takes at most 10 seconds…
options.connection.disconnected: Disconnected. Everything this browser kept for your account is deleted. Plays already sent stay in your account: to remove them, or this connection, open Connected services in {product}.
options.connection.disconnected_sent: {count, plural, one {# play was sent first.} other {# plays were sent first.}}
options.connection.disconnected_deleted: {count, plural, one {# play couldn't be sent and was deleted.} other {# plays couldn't be sent and were deleted.}}
options.sites.title: Sites
options.sites.lead: Where the extension looks for films and episodes. It reads a page only once a video plays there.
options.sites.allowed_empty: None yet. While a video plays on another site, allow it from the toolbar button.
options.sites.exclude_invalid: That isn't a site address. Type one like example.com.
options.sites.failed: Couldn't save that change — try again.
options.counting.title: Counting
options.counting.lead: What you play is measured over its story, from the end of the intro to the start of the credits, so skipped intros and long end credits never count against it.
options.counting.finish: A film or an episode is added when you've played {percent, number} % of its story
options.counting.finish_detail: Sent the moment you reach it, wherever you are in the story. Anything played less is never sent.
options.counting.start_on: Films you start are saved in progress after {percent, number} % (at least {minutes, number} min)
options.counting.start_on_any: Films you start are saved in progress after {percent, number} %
options.counting.start_detail: Saved in your library as in progress, so {product} can remind you to finish it.
options.counting.where: Both are set in your {product} account, for every connected service. The extension can't change them.
options.privacy.title: Privacy
options.privacy.incognito_detail: Off unless you turn it on. When on, what you watch there is kept and sent like anything else, and stays after the window closes.
options.privacy.incognito_chrome: Chrome also needs to allow the extension in incognito, on its page in Chrome's extension settings.
options.privacy.history_days_detail: Plays already sent, and what {product} answered, leave this browser after this long. Your diary in {product} keeps them.
options.privacy.history_detail: What was sent and what {product} answered, kept for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in this browser.
options.privacy.history_clear_confirm: This deletes the plays already sent, and what {product} answered about them, from this browser. Your diary in {product} isn't touched. Plays not sent yet, what you're watching now, your settings and the connection stay.
options.privacy.history_clear_failed: Couldn't clear the history — try again.
options.privacy.export_detail: Your settings, open viewings, history and plays waiting to be sent, as a JSON file. Never the connection or its key.
options.privacy.exported: Exported. The file is in your downloads.
options.privacy.export_refused: The export held sign-in details, so it wasn't saved. Please report this.
options.privacy.clear_detail: Deletes everything the extension keeps in this browser, its connection included.
options.privacy.clear_confirm: This deletes your history, open viewings, plays not sent yet, settings and this browser's connection. Your diary in {product} isn't touched.
options.privacy.cleared: Cleared. Connect again to keep adding what you watch.
options.privacy.change_failed: Couldn't save that change — try again.
options.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
options.diagnostics.lead: For reporting a service that isn't tracked right. Nothing here leaves your browser unless you attach it to a report.
options.diagnostics.log_detail: Off by default. Records what the extension did, kept for 7 days, with sign-in details removed.
options.diagnostics.entries_detail: Save the log to attach it to a report.
options.diagnostics.log_failed: Couldn't read the log — try again.
options.diagnostics.change_failed: Couldn't save that change — try again.
options.diagnostics.capture_detail: Records what the extension reads on the page that played last, with accounts, profiles, e-mail addresses, tokens and URL queries removed. Read it before you attach it.
options.diagnostics.capture_empty: Nothing to capture yet. Play the video in its tab, then capture again.
options.diagnostics.capture_failed: Couldn't capture the page — try again.
options.diagnostics.part.address_detail: the site and the page's path, with query values removed, and the part after # as the page wrote it
options.diagnostics.part.open_graph_deta: the tags that say what the page is
options.diagnostics.part.page_data_detai: only what the site's module declared
options.diagnostics.part.signals_detail: whether an ad or the end is showing
options.diagnostics.removed.query_values: {count, plural, one {# query value} other {# query values}}
options.diagnostics.removed.named_entrie: {count, plural, one {# entry named for an account or a profile} other {# entries named for an account or a profile}}
options.diagnostics.removed.emails: {count, plural, one {# e-mail address} other {# e-mail addresses}}
options.diagnostics.removed.links_with_q: {count, plural, one {# link with a query} other {# links with a query}}
options.diagnostics.removed.overlong: {count, plural, one {# overlong string} other {# overlong strings}}
options.diagnostics.capture_where: Nothing is sent. The file is saved only when you press Save sample. If you attach it to a GitHub issue, anyone can read it.
options.about.title: About
options.about.fingerprint_detail: A SHA-256 of this build's code. Compare it with the one published with the release.
options.about.notices_detail: The open-source code and fonts this extension includes, each with its licence.
privacy.inventory.title: What the {product} extension keeps
privacy.inventory.lead: Everything it stores or sends, where, and for how long.
privacy.inventory.reading.what: What a page says is playing, and how far it has got
privacy.inventory.reading.where: Memory, then this browser's extension storage
privacy.inventory.reading.kept: Until the viewing is added or skipped, 7 days without watching, or you disconnect
privacy.inventory.play.what: A watched film or episode: the fields shown in What was sent
privacy.inventory.play.where: This browser until it is sent, then the local history
privacy.inventory.play.kept: History: 1, 7 or 30 days, as you choose (7 to begin with), or until you disconnect
privacy.inventory.start.what: A film you started, if your {product} account saves starts: the same fields as a play, without when it was watched
privacy.inventory.start.where: This browser until it is sent, then the local history
privacy.inventory.start.kept: History: 1, 7 or 30 days, as you choose (7 to begin with), or until you disconnect
privacy.inventory.rule.what: Your account's two lines — when a viewing is added, when a film you start is saved — as {product} last said
privacy.inventory.rule.kept: Until you disconnect; a new connection reads its own
privacy.inventory.answer.kept: As long as the history, or until you disconnect
privacy.inventory.connection.what: Your connection to {product} and its key
privacy.inventory.connection.leaves: The connection, to {product} only. The key never.
privacy.inventory.connection.kept: Until you disconnect, or it expires
privacy.inventory.account.what: Which {product} account the connection is for: a code that tells accounts apart without naming anyone, on each play and viewing
privacy.inventory.account.kept: As long as what it is on, or until you disconnect
privacy.inventory.diagnostics.what: The diagnostics log, if you turn it on
privacy.inventory.diagnostics.where: This browser, with sign-in details removed
privacy.inventory.diagnostics.leaves: Only if you attach it to a report
privacy.inventory.nothing_else: Nothing else is sent anywhere: no analytics, no telemetry, no crash reports, no third parties.
popup.disconnected.title: Not connected
popup.disconnected.body: Connect {product} to add the films and episodes you watch to your diary.
popup.now.heading: Now playing on {service}
popup.site.heading: This site
popup.notice.revoked: This connection was ended or has run out. Reconnect {product} to keep adding what you watch.
popup.now.track_declined: Chrome didn't allow it, so this site isn't tracked.
popup.now.track_failed: Couldn't start tracking this site — try again.
popup.now.state.skipped: Skipped — this one won't be added
popup.reason.incognito_detail: You can turn this on in settings, under Privacy.
popup.reason.not_player_page_detail: Previews and trailers here aren't tracked.
popup.reason.short: Under 2 minutes — looks like a trailer or an ad
popup.reason.muted: Started muted — turn the sound on to track it
popup.reason.page_silent: This page doesn't say what's playing
popup.reason.series_no_episode: This page doesn't say which episode is playing
popup.reason.no_title: This page doesn't name what's playing
popup.reason.player_unreachable: Something is playing where {product} can't see it
popup.reason.player_unreachable_detail: Often a player embedded from another site.
popup.waiting.heading: Waiting for you
popup.recent.heading: Recently
popup.recent.empty: Nothing sent yet. What you watch shows up here.
popup.sent.missing: This play is no longer kept in this browser.
popup.pause.indefinitely: Until I turn it back on
popup.pause.paused_indefinitely: Paused until you turn it back on
popup.pause.failed: Couldn't change the pause — try again.
